critical_evidence.evidence: No borescope and no engine-rebuild or re-sleeve invoices are mentioned for this 83k-mile M97 3.4. Cylinders 4-6 condition is unknown.
No DME over-rev report is provided. The car has four prior owners and an aftermarket short shifter.

No water-pump, coolant-pipe, AOS, clutch or major-service documentation is shown. The 11 Carfax service entries are not itemised. The only stated work is an ignition switch and O2 sensor (June 2026, seller claim).

documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN matching the decode, a Carfax summary with owner count and a damage event, title state, and itemised equipment. The maintenance half is absent: no invoices, no borescope, no DME report and no cooling or AOS records. The 2019 damage has no repair detail.

condition.rationale: Observed faults are a cracked windshield and a reported front-damage event with unknown repair. Photos show tidy paint and interior, but nothing establishes engine-bore, cooling or clutch condition on an 83k-mile M97. Videos exist but are not evidence of cylinder-wall health.

price_value.rationale: There is no price yet. The fair value estimate is $23,909–$30,212. This car's tuner-style mods, damage history, four owners, missing records and windshield replacement argue for a hammer below the mid-point, and even a below-fair price carries open M97 engine risk.

mission_fit.rationale: The profile accepts a 3.4 Cayman S as a keeper only with unusually strong engine due diligence, and none is present. A modified, 83k-mile car with no records is not the documented, stock-leaning keeper the brief favours, and it ties up keeper money during a cash-preservation bridge period.

logistics.rationale: Texas private seller via BaT, with shipping available or a fly-and-drive option. PPI access before bidding is not stated. California registration hinges on CARB EO status of the plenum and exhaust.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A manual Cayman S with Preferred Plus, Bi-Xenon and heated memory seats is desirable. That is offset by a cluster of aftermarket appearance and audio pieces (Maxton aero, smoked taillights, Kenwood screen, subwoofer, spoiler extension) on a common Arctic Silver car.

evidence.mission_note: A 3.4 Cayman S manual is a legitimate keeper target, but the profile requires unusually strong engine due diligence and this listing supplies none, while adding modifications and an undocumented damage event. It would compete for cash during a bridge period without the documented superiority the keeper brief requires.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-matched 2007 Cayman S six-speed with 82,549 Carfax miles, four prior owners and a Texas title, and the photos confirm the manual gearbox and a long list of aftermarket parts. Observed issues are a Carfax-reported front 'minor damage' event in November 2019 with no repair information, and a disclosed cracked windshield. The powertrain has an IPD plenum and Soul exhaust with no receipts or CARB EO numbers, so California smog feasibility is open. All three model-critical items are missing: no borescope, no DME over-rev report and no cooling, AOS or water-pump records. The only stated service is an undocumented June 2026 ignition switch and O2 sensor. The current seller has owned the car since April 2026, so the history depends on the unshown contents of the 11 Carfax entries. Expected hammer sits around or below the fair value band, but engine condition on this M97 is entirely unproven.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller via BaT before bidding to request a specialist PPI with borescope and DME over-rev report in the Austin area, the full Carfax with prior invoices, and the reserve status and tire date codes.
